Create an education app that has the following functions:
1.The main use of the app is for users to upload their homework given by their teachers and their answers to the homework given via pictures. The homework can only be in the form of an essay or composition. An Ai will evaluate the quality of the work, and give xp points to the user accordingly. These xp points will add to the users level. The user starts from level 1 and every ten levels, the user will get a prize. The prize will be the code of a robux giftcard but since this is just a prototype, just generate a random code. Each level requires 1000 xp points. 
2. The amount of xp given for each piece of homework will give xp ranging from 1 to 100
3.The Ai used to evaluate the homework quality has to be honest with the points that it gives the user. The scoring of the homework will strictly follow this rubric:
A. Relevance & central idea (Idea)
B. Structure & paragraphing (Structure)
C. Content & details / evidence (Content & Evidence)
D. Language clarity & accuracy (Language)
E. Voice, style, and emotional impact (Voice)
4.Repeatedly submitting homework that has already been submitted before will not result in getting xp points.
5. On the first submission the Ai will always give at least 50 xp points, so as to encourage the user. Everytime the amount of xp points the user gets from a single piece of work increases as compared to the previous piece work, there will be a +10% xp bonus for the next 2 essays/compositions.
6. After evaluating, the compo/essay, the ai will give relevant, constructive feedback to help the user improve, no matter how poorly the student did. The Ai still has to be brutally honest with the xp points that the ai gives the user.
7. Include a co-pilot feature. The co-pilot mode will be for users who may not have the ability to complete the work that was given to them. the co-pilot mode will have an ai that can give the user inspiration for the compo/essay whenever the user is stuck. However the ai strictly must not give the student answers directly, in any kind of way, no matter what prompts the user give the ai. in the co-pilot mode, the user will receive 4 times less xp points.
8. The appearance of the app must look visually appealing to students from ages 11-16

**Defining App Core Features**

I'm now zeroing in on defining the core features of the React app for students. The plan is to include photo essay uploads, AI evaluation for experience points, levels, and prizes. I'm also planning to incorporate a strict, rubric-based scoring system, anti-duplication measures, and a specific XP logic with bonuses. "Co-Pilot" mode is envisioned to inspire learning.


**Refining Tech Stack Choices**

I've decided on React 18+ and TypeScript as the framework and language, respectively. Tailwind CSS will handle styling. For AI, I'm leaning toward the Gemini API, using `gemini-3-pro-preview` for complex tasks and `gemini-3-flash-preview` for speed. Recharts will handle data visualization. I've also solidified the gamification logic with XP, Levels, and Prizes, along with anti-duplication measures and XP bonus strategies, and a defined scoring system. I am keeping "Co-Pilot" mode and the specific prompts/requirements in mind as well.


**Detailing Application Components**

I'm now detailing each component, thinking through the React app's structure. I'm focusing on UI elements like rounded cards and animations. I've broken down components like the dashboard, submission form, and evaluation results, including `localStorage` for user state persistence. I also will integrate XP bonus state with a counter. I've planned out file structures, from metadata to the index, defining interfaces and services.
